evidence: Spelling: extracted all 496 distinct word tokens from instruction.md plus the three /instructions notes and read them in full; every token is a correctly spelled English word, proper name (Anand, Lloyd, Pryce, Rowe, Kittle, Harriet, Gwen, Paul, Sian) or technical term (sqlite, cdn, json, px, http/https, api, db). Spelling is consistent British-neutral; contractions (mustn't, won't, can't, we'll) are correct. Contamination grep: `TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|<placeholder>|lorem|tbd`, foreign paths (`C:\`, `/Users/`, `/home/`, `F:/`) and angle-bracket placeholders return no hits in the brief or notes; the only 'placeholder' matches are product wording (conversations.md:9 'leaves the same placeholder as one a timer removed'; walls-and-retention.md:35 'appears only as a placeholder'). The template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt...' line has been fully replaced. Byte scan: all four files are pure ASCII (0 bytes >127, so no zero-width/smart-quote residue), no BOM, no CR, newline-terminated. No author asides, duplicated paragraphs, or grader vocabulary pasted in. Contradiction checks: one clock only (integration.md:7 '2026-05-12T11:00:00Z' == seed 'clock' == app_context.md:27); one seed path (instruction.md:5 and integration.md:5 both '/assets/seed_data.json', and Dockerfile copies assets/ to /assets/; copying it into /app is an extra step, not a second source); one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11 table matches seed accounts exactly in email, name and role); one port (integration.md:3 '3000' == app_context.md:4); notes path '/instructions' matches Dockerfile COPY. Wall statement 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12 today' (walls-and-retention.md:15) matches seed M-12 walled ['dev@kittle.test']; timer options 'off, 1 day, 7 days or 30 days' (walls-and-retention.md:23) match seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30]. Hold/delete rules agree across files (conversations.md:9 'unless a partner has put them on hold' vs walls-and-retention.md:29 'Nobody, including its author, can delete a held message'); placeholder-for-deleted-with-replies agrees (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:25,35); unauthenticated behaviour agrees (instruction.md:7, integration.md:9) and is compatible with the always-200 health endpoint (integration.md:3), which serves no matter data. Observation (not a defect): seed K-2 prior version body 'Landlords notice recieved.' is a deliberate in-fiction typo demonstrating edit history (current body 'Landlord's notice received and filed.'); it is seed data, not instruction text. Adversarial view: a model cannot be misled by a stray path, leftover TODO or conflicting value because none exists; a conforming app cannot fail on a contradiction in the text because the brief, notes, seed and app_context agree on every shared fact checked. This row is purely textual, so no runtime evidence is required; deterministic checkers check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py were not present in the frozen rules and were not executed (the deterministic reviewer owns them).
